wasm.changes: Historical parity oracle only; no longer included in extension output or loaded at runtime.

goRuntime.changes: Historical parity oracle only; no longer imported or included in extension output.

gomanize.embeddedData: Hindi lexicon.tsv, schwa_tree.json and roman_ngrams.tsv derive from Dakshina train data, CC BY-SA 4.0. Unmodified pinned data is now downloaded on demand, verified by exact size and SHA-256, and cached for offline use; no longer embedded in the extension. See reading-annotation-NOTICE.md.

implementationChanges.kind: MIT TypeScript port of the pinned Hindi parser, consonant runs, four rule phases, lexicon-first lookup, default/learned-schwa candidates and UTF-8 character-ngram reranking
implementationChanges.options: Equivalent to lexicon:true,rerank:true; rerank also evaluates the SchwaModel:true alternative; no Go runtime, WASM or downloaded code.

lexicon.tsv.changes: none; exact bytes at npmGitHead; parsed only as data

roman_ngrams.tsv.changes: none; exact bytes at npmGitHead; parsed only as data

schwa_tree.json.changes: none; exact bytes at npmGitHead; parsed only as data

testDataSubset.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 for derived Hindi lexicon/ngram data and unchanged schwa tree
testDataSubset.changes: Only lexicon entries and ngram counts needed for the frozen parity corpus are retained; all unigrams retained to preserve score denominators. Not included in extension output. Expected outputs recorded from original @budhash/gomanize@1.2.1 WASM.

koroman.licenseNormalization: Original malformed LICENSE preserved byte-for-byte in the gzip archive; only merge-conflict markers and duplicate heading removed from reading-koroman-MIT.txt
koroman.implementationChanges: none; imported from fixed npm package

doublearray.scope: unmodified runtime dependency of @faanau/kuromoji, bundled in Japanese engine chunk
